mentions.name: Freest
mentions.description: This is a multiplayer AI music-generation party game. Players join a shared screen from their phones, submit their verses from a set of helper prompts, and hear those ideas turned into short generated rap battle performances. It also offers a non-shared-screen mode intended to be played globally with friends and strangers.
mentions.problem: For the non-shared-screen global mode, the builders are having a hard time figuring out how to incentivize players to go after one another on diss-tracks with minimal knowledge of the opponent.
mentions.audience: Party game players joining from their phones, with a mode intended to be played globally with friends and strangers
